name: Chang Watch
description_short: Vote distribution and DRep insights dashboard.
description_long: Open-source Cardano governance dashboard that visualizes voting power distribution as donut charts, broken down by governance action type and by voting entity — Constitutional Committee, DReps, SPOs, and combined totals. Includes a toggle for including or excluding inactive DReps. DRep and stake pool data is sourced from Koios, pool group data from Balance Analytics. Built by community member Cerkoryn as a SvelteKit app.
